Class hubs

Invite students to a ready quarterly bundle, a tailored bundle, a level or an exam. Each student gets one personal link. Their page is live: anything you add to their hubs appears straight away.

Ready bundles – every quarter

Prepare the links once for each level and exam, for every quarter of the year. They are offered automatically when you record a sale. Need something special for one student? Press ✂️ next to their name to get their own copy to tailor.

Compositions

Everything your students have handed in. Open a student's folder to read, correct and send back.

Diary

Reminders appear here 3 weeks before a 3-month bundle ends, so you can plan new material in time. Exam dates from your students' profiles appear here too.

To use the diary and exam dates, run learning-hub-update-diary.sql once in Supabase (SQL Editor → New query → paste → Run), then reload this page.

Partner teachers

Then create her login (once): Supabase → Authentication → Users → Add user → Create new user. Type the same email and a password, tick Auto Confirm User, and click Create. She logs in on the same Learning Hub address with that email and password, and can change the password with “Forgot password”.

Invite students

Invite settings

Add the web address where this app is hosted (for example your Vercel or GitHub Pages link) so the links open for your students.

Individual links

Pick any app or link just for this student, for example only the BIM material or only TED talks. They appear in a “⭐ Just for you” hub on the student's page, next to any hubs they are in. TED talks never reach students automatically: they only get the ones you pick here or put in a bundle.

Remove links

Everything this student gets, hub by hub. Untick an app to take it away from this student only: the hub and your other students are not affected. A link that is in two of their hubs is shown only once, in the first hub (marked “duplicate” below), so you don't need to remove duplicates by hand.

    Backup & restore

    Saves your links, bundles, students, hubs, progress and composition records in one file. The uploaded composition files themselves stay safely in your database storage.

    Adds everything from the file. Items that already exist are updated; nothing is deleted. Backups from the older, offline version work too.

    Deleted links (0)
